pages.text: A machine that processes items, fluid and FE using dedicated recipes.$(br2)Check the reactor recipes in JEI, place the ingredients in the input slots, and supply the required fluid and FE. Finished items are placed in the output slot.

pages.title: Product Samples
pages.text: For recipes that require a sample, place the specified product in the sample slot. The sample is not consumed.$(br2)Leave the sample slot empty for recipes that do not require one. Samples cannot be removed during processing.

pages.title: Supported Upgrades
pages.text: Supports Crafting Tool, Speed, Energy Efficiency, Energy Capacity and Tank Capacity Upgrades.$(br2)The required Crafting Tool tier depends on the recipe. If processing stops, check the status display, FE supply, fluid supply and output space.

pages.title: Alternative Recipes
pages.text: Reactor recipes include Alchemical Base Paper, upgrades, Unite Alloy and high-density materials.$(br2)Their ingredients and requirements differ from workbench recipes; check the reactor recipe in JEI.$(br2)External item transport can supply ingredients and extract products. Set the sample and upgrades in the machine screen.
